literal_meaning: নাড়ানাড়ি বা নড়াচড়ার শব্দমালা (reduplicative sound of shaking or swaying)
figurative_meaning_en: reduplicative sound; fidgeting; idle movement or chatter
example_sentences_in_english: There's a rustling sound in the market.
note: Often used to describe unnecessary noise or talk in everyday Bengali contexts
